projects.title: Preppy
projects.description: Preppy is a progressive web application (PWA) that allows users to create a list of food in their household(via manual input, barcode scanning, and image analysis), and receive recipe recommendations based on the ingredients they have available.

projects.title: CESV-11
projects.description: CESV-11 is a mock e-commerce website that offers the latest selection of smartphones on the market. Developed with CRUD in mind, this single page application was created with React, Redux, Express, PSQL, Sequelize, Node, Passport, and Heroku for deployment.
